newsitem.title: EGYPT: Suez Cement pays 4.5 LE dividend in July.
newsitem.headline: Suez Cement pays 4.5 LE dividend in July.

text.p: Suez Cement said on Wednesday it would pay out a 4.50 pound dividend per share for calendar 1996. The dividend in 1995 was 5.20 pounds.
Shareholders approved the dividend at their general meeting last month, the firm said in a published statement.
It added Egyptian pound payments were available at Bank of Alexandria branches and U.S. dollar payments would be made in Cairo. The dividend is payable from July 27.
The share closed down 0.28 pounds at 65.8 on Tuesday.
Suez Cement said in June it made net profits of 297.294 million pounds ($87.58 million) in 1996, 1.2 percent up on 293.700 million in 1995.
For 1995, the company distributed 254.800 million pounds to shareholders through an annual dividend of 5.20 pounds per each of its 49 million shares.
